title: M1no-Study - Early Identification of Infants With High Type 1 Diabetes Risk for Participation in Primary Prevention Trials
official: Identification of Infants With Increased Type 1 Diabetes Risk for Enrollment Into Primary Prevention Trials.
summary: The goal of this observational study is to identify newborns at increased genetic risk of developing type 1 diabetes-specific beta-cell autoantibodies in order to determine eligibility for participation in primary prevention randomized controlled trials aimed at preventing beta-cell autoimmunity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Screening is performed between the ages of 0 and 6 weeks.
* Consent form signed by parents/guardian.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Infants aged above 6 weeks.
* Refusal to participate in the study
